title: Griddo — AI-Ready DXP for Higher Education
subheading: Structured for discovery. Built for agents.
hero_description: Griddo delivers the content architecture that makes universities visible to AI search engines — and ships a native MCP server so your agents can create, edit, and publish directly inside the platform.
description: Griddo is a no-code Digital Experience Platform (DXP) designed exclusively for universities. Built on a MACH (Microservices, API, Cloud, Headless) architecture, Griddo empowers universities to manage digital assets, create websites, and publish content with ease and efficiency. Deployed at the edge, its serverless infrastructure offers maximum security and performance.
summary_of_benefits: Griddo streamlines content management, enhances brand consistency, and reduces time to market by up to 50% — speeding up the path from content to publication by 10x.
repository_purpose: This repository hosts resources, documentation, and examples related to Griddo's capabilities for higher education DXP needs.

sections.title: Why Griddo?
sections.content: Griddo is a GEO-optimized DXP built to deliver content that AI engines discover and cite — and that AI agents can act on. With a native MCP server, your agents can read, write, and publish directly inside Griddo, extending the author experience beyond the UI and into your own workflows. Purpose-made for universities and educational institutions seeking a modern, user-friendly platform to manage multiple websites, landing pages, and events. Griddo's no-code interface, AI-driven tools, and modular design make it ideal for cross-functional teams — marketing, content, communications, and research — without requiring programming expertise.
sections.additional_info: Additionally, Griddo is the only DXP with a fully brand-tailored Design System at its heart, guaranteeing that all content created with Griddo adheres to the university's visual identity.

quote.text: Griddo is a very intuitive platform that allows us to scale our many web projects easily. Its modular structure gives us absolute autonomy to manage digital assets.
quote.author: Sara Hontoria, Centro de Estudios Garrigues

features.name: No-Code Interface
features.description: Build and manage pages with a drag-and-drop builder, instant previews at any device resolution, and no coding required.

features.name: Modular Design System
features.description: Create flexible, responsive layouts with reusable modules, ensuring brand consistency across all sites and landing pages.

features.name: AI-Powered Tools
list: Content personalization with Griddo Personal Experience (GPX)

features.name: Multi-Site Management
features.description: Centralize control of multiple websites, landing pages, news, events, and faculty profiles with content reuse capabilities. Structure all your marketing campaigns in one interface.

features.name: MACH Architecture
list: Microservices: Independent services that manage internal and external integrations across your institution.
API-first: A RESTful API combined with internal GraphQL handles content delivery and service integration.
Cloud-native: Fully managed SaaS on AWS — secure, scalable, and always up to date.
Headless: Use Griddo as your content hub regardless of your front end.
MCP Server: Connect your AI agents to Griddo and run reports, analysis, and bulk tasks directly from your workflow.

features.name: Cloud Native Infrastructure
list: Serverless deployment for enhanced security and reliability

features.name: SEO and GEO Performance
features.description: Generates bot-readable static HTML, optimizes load times, and achieves top Core Web Vitals scores. Content architecture optimized for AI search engine discovery and citation (GEO).

features.name: Role-Based Collaboration
features.description: Assign permissions for SEO, analytics, content, and design teams, with traceability for external collaborators.

features.name: Digital Asset Management
features.description: Griddo Images optimizes media handling for efficient content workflows.

features.name: Integrations
features.tagline: Connect with any system. Data stays in sync, everywhere.
features.description: Griddo's API-first architecture connects to any system your institution already runs — SIS, CRM, LMS, analytics platforms, and external data sources. RESTful and GraphQL APIs handle bi-directional data flow, so a change in one system propagates across your entire digital ecosystem automatically. One unified data layer. Every team working from the same source of truth.
list: CRM: Salesforce, Zoho CRM, MS Dynamics

sections.title: Scalability
sections.content: Universities run some of the most complex digital environments in any sector — hundreds of sites, thousands of pages, multiple languages, dozens of independent departments. Griddo already operates at that scale, managing each institution's full digital ecosystem from a single platform. That same architecture extends horizontally across content volume and vertically across infrastructure demand, backed by AWS auto-scaling and a microservices design built to absorb institutional-scale load without compromising performance.

sections.title: How It Works

steps.description: Use the intuitive drag-and-drop builder to create pages with modular components, ensuring 100% responsive designs.
Centralize content (news, events, faculty profiles) across multiple sites with reusable modules.
Use AI tools for automated image tagging, translations, and SEO optimization.
Assign roles to marketing, content, and design teams for seamless teamwork.
Deploy content instantly with real-time previews, optimized for performance and accessibility.

sections.technical_details: Griddo is built on TypeScript, Node.js, and React, using a serverless cloud infrastructure for high performance and scalability.
